findings.claim: FY2025 10-K 描述銷售通路主要為直銷辦公室、製造商代表、經銷商與配銷商；10-K 該節未載明通路結構性轉變。
findings.excerpt: Distribution and sales occur primarily through direct sales offices, manufacturers’ representatives, resellers, and distributors.

findings.claim: Piper Sandler 會議摘要：Roper 設有 25–30 人 AI accelerator 團隊協助各事業開發 agentic 產品；CentralReach 以 freemium 模式帶動快速採用。
findings.source: Quartr, Piper Sandler 5th Annual Growth Frontiers Conference summary
findings.excerpt: CentralReach led AI adoption, using a freemium model to drive rapid uptake and ROI in autism therapy workflow. Applied learnings from CentralReach to other businesses like Vertafore, accelerating AI product rollout and adoption. AI accelerator team of 25–30 helps businesses develop agentic products, sharing expertise

note: 兩次搜尋未見 2026 年通路或 go-to-market 結構性轉變的報導；商業模式向垂直軟體／訂閱的轉移為長期趨勢，僅有二手來源，未取得可逐字原文。 線索 1 條，程式核實 1 條
